text:
anna (Product): FYI — ACME Legal flagged that their EU pilot needs a darklaunch with customer-managed KMS and cross-region mirroring. They're asking for per-tenant opt-in + A/B against baseline. Can we scope?

eli (Eng): That's a big ask. KMS + per-tenant darklaunch means Private or Dedicated, right? Hosted would need envelope encryption w/bring-your-key, which we don't fully support for partial traffic routing.

mike (SRE): We can simulate mirroring via shadow traffic to EU cluster, but it's extra network/backpressure risk. Need fallback plan if mirroring causes latency spikes.

sasha (Solutions): ACME wants the rollout to look like: 1) 1% tenant shadow (no impact), 2) 10% opt-in cohort with feature-flag, 3) expand to 50% with A/B quality checks, then full. Also require audit logs to show KMS key IDs used.

jordan (Customer Success): They want a hard kill-switch accessible to their ops + ours. Legal requires proof of deletion window if keys revoked.

eli (Eng): Proposal sketch: feature flag naming: `acme_eu_darklaunch_v1`. Routes: opt-in flag -> route to EU private deployment (if enrolled) else hit hosted fallback. Mirror path: `?mirror=true` header. Telemetry: per-tenant evals and embed sampling. Example config: 

```
{
  "flag": "acme_eu_darklaunch_v1",
  "cohorts": ["shadow","opt-in-10","ab-50"],
  "mirror_header": "x-mirror-to-eu",
  "kms_integration": "BYOK",
  "kill_switch": "/ops/flags/acme_eu_darklaunch_v1/disable"
}
```

mike (SRE): Notes: if we mirror with `x-mirror-to-eu` we must throttle mirror queue and set backpressure policy. Fallback policy idea: on >150ms p95 increases in EU path, auto-fail to global-hosted model and alert.

anna (Product): Timeline ask from ACME: pilot starts in 6 weeks. We need decision on: hosted BYOK support vs Dedicated-only; whether we can offer audited KMS logs; and can we support A/B comparisons (statistical significance tracking).

sasha (Solutions): For A/B we can wire their telemetry to our evals pipeline and provide daily regressions. Significance: we use Bayesian online delta; need to confirm thresholds with ACME PM.

eli (Eng): Rough engineering estimate: 3 wks to add safe mirror + backpressure + kill-switch controls, 2 wks for BYOK envelope support (hosted) + audit logs, 1 wk for flag flow + rollout UI. Total ~6 weeks tight. Depends on infra priority and one SRE to implement throttles.

mike (SRE): We should require a preflight smoke that runs a 24h shadow at 0.1% and runs latency/kpi checks before opt-in. Also add a capacity reservation for EU nodes during the pilot window.

anna (Product): Decision needed: do we force ACME into Dedicated/Private to meet KMS audit reqs, or accept added dev work to support hosted BYOK? Tradeoffs: Dedicated = slower sales cadence but simpler infra+legal; hosted BYOK = more ops work but better for PLG.

jordan (Customer Success): ACME says procurement timeline prefers hosted if BYOK available — they want minimal procurement friction.

eli (Eng): My recommendation: proceed with hosted BYOK path but gated: a) implement envelope BYOK + audit logs, b) implement throttled mirror + kill-switch, c) contractually limit pilot to low qps and reserved capacity. If timelines slip, pivot to Dedicated offering.

anna (Product): OK. Action items: @eli own BYOK + audit logs (2w), @mike own mirror throttles and p95 auto-fail (3w), @sasha draft rollout config & PM-runbook for ACME (this week), @jordan coordinate procurement ask. I'll update roadmap and flag the pilot as "customer-driven" and mark scope with rollback SLA.

deploy-bot: Scheduled check: reminder to add rollback playbook to release job. :robot_face: 

sasha (Solutions): I'll draft the customer-facing runbook and include explicit kill-switch steps + contact numbers. Will share a draft by EOD tomorrow.

eli (Eng): One more thing — we should add an experiment tag so telemetry can join their internal metrics (user ids hashed with salt). I'll add the flag metadata for correlation.

anna (Product): Great. I'll add a launch gating checklist: 24h shadow, SLO pass, BYOK audit present, signed pilot contract, capacity reservation. If all green, move to opt-in.

mike (SRE): I posted a quick curl to test mirror header in staging: 
```
curl -H "x-mirror-to-eu: true" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"test"}' https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

jordan (Customer Success): ACME PM asks: can we include a 30-day data retention proof in the audit report? I'll collect exact ask and loop them in.

anna (Product): Thanks all — will sync with legal and ops and reconvene mid-next-week. :thumbsup:
